description: This file defines an enum 'SignificantLocationMonitor' that manages monitoring significant location changes on iOS devices. It starts location monitoring if the mode is set to 'always' and the app is authorized. When a location change occurs, it encodes the location data as JSON and sends a 'location.update' event via a gateway, allowing other parts of the app to respond to significant location updates.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: A simple Codable struct to hold location data: latitude, longitude, accuracy, and source.

methods.name: startIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts monitoring significant location changes if the location mode is 'always' and authorization is granted. It sets up a callback to handle location updates by encoding location data into JSON and sending it through a gateway.
